security_context.title: October 2026 security assessment and election-period threat reporting
security_context.summary: An attributed security assessment reported 519 nationwide incidents in October 2026 and warned that election-period risks included attacks on opposition supporters, campaign-material destruction and other political violence. The article also reported agency-level operational tallies and official statements, but those figures are treated as attributed claims from the published report rather than independently verified counts.
